pages.title: Oblivion Scythe
pages.text: §lWeapon Stats: §r$(br)Base attack damage 15, attack speed 2.5, durability 4025.$(br2)§lActive Skill: §r$(br)Right-click to fire a straight particle blade 16 blocks long, dealing 1.25x normal attack damage. The blade has a 2.5-second cooldown. Each consecutive hit adds +1 base damage, up to 30; resets after more than 2 seconds between hits.
